title: astragalus lentiginosus var. coulteri
intro: Astragalus lentiginosus var. coulteri, commonly known as Coulteri's milkvetch, is a variety of the Astragalus lentiginosus plant, belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). This perennial herb is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, and it has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. Coulteri's milkvetch is believed to have anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The plant's bioactive constituents include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its potential to exhibit antiviral, antibacterial, and anticancer properties.
